summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Optimi Health Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer, attaching a press release announcing the launch of standardized microdose psilocybin products at 1mg and 2mg dosages for clinical research. There are no terms of a merger, acquisition, tender offer, spinning off, restructuring, or any special-situation event. The filing is a product and business development update. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics appear. The filing does not relate to a special-situation category. It is a routine current report of a foreign issuer.
